items.statement: The computed HPY 10a structure supports the paper's qualitative geometry claim: a largely coplanar central hydrazone-linked framework with substantially twisted substituent groups, within the scope and uncertainty of the submitted model.
items.expected: The conclusion explicitly connects the validated geometry and the three mapped dihedrals to the near-coplanar-core/out-of-plane-substituent interpretation, and states limitations.

items.statement: The reported HOMO/LUMO values are attached to the same validated HPY 10a structure and are interpreted only as ground-state model outputs.
items.expected: The conclusion or results provenance binds HOMO/LUMO to the selected validated structure and does not overclaim experimental or method-independent agreement.
